decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment sits far from the firm's maritime crewing knowledge base, so it can draw little on existing absorptive capacity, but it is still shown on the website in 2024 and gives some diversification.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core seafarer crewing and training expertise, so it can interpret market feedback and improve the service.

The Smart Academy extends the firm's established maritime training competence and is growing quickly through cooperation with six maritime institutions, which feeds external knowledge back into the firm.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance draws on the firm's technical ship management know-how, is driven by regulation, and has already delivered results by meeting the plan submission deadline for all vessels.
The dashboard is fully integrated into the firm's own PAL ship management software, so it builds on in-house development capability and supports the compliance service.
The cost simulator complements the compliance services and the PAL software, letting the firm apply its regulatory and operational data knowledge to give clients commercial value.
